title: Preorders are open
excerpt: Request a bake with one week's notice. There is no minimum.
body:
Preorders are open for the current menu — sourdough, cookies, cookie platters, cakes, lemon bars, rugelach, dessert cups, and pavlova — and for custom bakes.

Please give at least one week's notice. There is no minimum order. Prices on the menu are placeholders; Chana confirms the real total by text before anything is baked. Custom orders are priced by message.

Nothing is charged on this website. Text 413-355-3682 if that is easier than the form.
